verdict.rationale: Morph's docs say one API key covers its open-weight chat models on shared, token-billed endpoints, with prefix caching on every open source model, but Kimi K3 is the only model family named. Nothing shows the breadth the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS or other named families in the catalog; a documented list showing catalog breadth and currency; independent corroboration of the serverless model lineup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools
Kimi K3 serves 1M context through the standard chat completions endpoint
Prefix caching is on for every open source model.
Anthropic Messages supports the same open source chat models, token billing, and rate limits.
